entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: PreNeg_Intro_1
entries.dialogueText: The heavy guns had fallen eerily silent along the smoke-shrouded Zille frontier and across the waters of the Gulf of Moridia. In the War Room, courier dispatches lay piled beside urgent telegrams from Konstantium. Wiktor Smolak had dispatched an envoy under a white flag proposing an immediate face-to-face parley.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita_PreNeg_Report
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty. Fighting has paused along the front. Both armies have expended immense ammunition reserves, and Smolak's envoy awaits your answer at the neutral border pavilion.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_PreNeg_Warning
entries.dialogueText: The Alliance of Nations has issued an urgent ceasefire appeal, Your Majesty. Both superpowers are watching closely. What we win at the table now depends entirely on the ground our troops hold.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo_PreNeg_Counsel
entries.dialogueText: Romus... Remember who Smolak is. He is a cornered fox who shifts between jester and butcher in a heartbeat. Guard the dignity of House Toras, whatever terms lie ahead.
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Romus_PreNeg_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: I looked across the map showing the final positions of our divisions from Brenas to the Gulf. The hour had come to face Wiktor Smolak in person.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Parley_Strength
entries.dialogueText: Prepare the royal armored motorcade. Assemble our escort and forward commanders. I will meet Smolak at the border pavilion and settle this face to face.
entries.menuText: "Prepare the royal motorcade. I will meet Smolak and negotiate under the royal standard."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Unconditional_Surrender
entries.dialogueText: Inform Smolak that if he tries to stall or play games at the pavilion, our batteries and ships will reopen fire within the hour. Let us go settle Zille's fate.
entries.menuText: "Tell Smolak our guns are still loaded—if he stalls, the bombardment resumes!"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_PreNeg_Lucita
entries.dialogueText: Lucita strapped on her sidearm and saluted with iron resolve. "The royal escort is mounted, Your Majesty. Let us bring this to an end."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos_PreNeg_Report
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty. A temporary ceasefire holds along the front lines. Both sides are exhausted of shells and fuel, and Smolak's envoy awaits our response at the neutral border pavilion.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_PreNeg_NoHugo
entries.dialogueText: Remember Smolak's nature, Your Majesty—he will alternate between clownish charm and sudden threats. Keep a cool head when you sit across from him.
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true)

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Ack_PreNeg_Carlos
entries.dialogueText: General Carlos Azaro snapped a crisp salute. "The armored escort is ready, Your Majesty."
